instructions: Combine the diced tomatoes with the fresh basil, dried oregano, a pinch of salt, 1 to 1½ tablespoons of the olive oil, and a splash (1 teaspoon) of balsamic vinegar. Chill.

Slice the baguette into ¼ to ½-inch slices. Cut off the end of the garlic clove and rub the garlic onto each side of each piece of bread. Drizzle both sides of the sliced bread with a little olive oil (or brush it on with a brush).
Toast on a grill or in a hot skillet until browned on both sides.
Top the hot bread with the cold tomato bruschetta and serve immediately.
notes: Adapted from a printout submitted as a screenshot (original source site unknown). The printout lists purple onion as added without a specified amount — use to taste. Chill the tomato mixture while the bread toasts so the topping goes on cold. Banner photo is a stock-style photo of bruschetta from a web image search, not the source's photo.
title: Authentic Italian Bruschetta
